title.value: JaxPruner: A Concise Library for Sparsity Research

extractions.description: The paper introduces JaxPruner, a JAX-based library implementing pruning and sparse training algorithms that integrates with Optax, and provides baseline experiments across four domains (image classification on ImageNet-2012, federated EMNIST, C4 language modelling with T5-Base, and Atari DQN).

type.quote: We demonstrate the ease of integration by providing examples in four different codebases: Scenic, t5x, Dopamine and FedJAX and provide baseline experiments on popular benchmarks.
type.justification: The paper presents a software library plus benchmark experiments.

name.quote: This work introduces JaxPruner, a JAX-based sparsity library for machine learning research.
name.justification: The library targets sparsity research and the paper contributes baselines.
